exposure: digital holistic health program "Baby Care Program" (BCP)
cohort: 512 primigravidas (255 in a 'Baby Care Program' intervention group, 257 in a control group).
finding: The Baby Care Program (BCP) was associated with improved sleep, reduced stress, lower incidence of preterm delivery and low birth weight, better maternal-fetal attachment, and fewer postpartum blues.
country: India (implied by mention of the joint family system and COVID)
birth_weight: Low birth weight (incidence measured, not specific weights)
